armies_of_renown.name: Beastclaw Alfrostun
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Ogor Mawtribes faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Beastclaw Alfrostun Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Ogor Mawtribes faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the ALFROSTUN keyword.
Any BEASTCLAW units
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

battle_traits.name: Masked by the Endless White
battle_traits.effect: Friendly ALFROSTUN units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" away.

battle_traits.name: A Clan of Hunters
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly Hunters with Sabrefangs unit to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: The target can use the 'Through the Frosts' ability even if another friendly Hunters with Sabrefangs unit has used that ability this battle.

battle_traits.name: Grasp of the Everwinter
battle_traits.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with any friendly ALFROSTUN units to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battle_traits.name: Run 'Em Down
battle_traits.effect: Each time an enemy unit in combat with a friendly ALFROSTUN unit uses a RETREAT ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: This mortal damage is in addition to any mortal damage inflicted on that enemy unit by that RETREAT ability.

battle_traits.name: Fearsome Breed
battle_traits.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of a friendly ALFROSTUN MONSTER. Subtract 2 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 6" of a friendly ALFROSTUN MONSTER instead.

entries.name: Hard-Bitten Chieftain
entries.effect: Other than the Companion ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target this unit made by enemy units that charged in the same turn have no effect.

entries.name: Alvagr Rune-Tokens
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 2 to chanting rolls for friendly ALFROSTUN units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Keening Gale
entries.declare: Pick a friendly ALFROSTUN PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly ALFROSTUN unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 2 to run rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, until the start of your next turn, add 2 to charge rolls for the target.

entries.name: Terrors of the Old Ice
entries.declare: Pick a friendly ALFROSTUN PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick an objective or terrain feature wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy units while they are contesting the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are contesting the target.

entries.name: Avalanche Voice
entries.declare: Pick a friendly ALFROSTUN PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time your opponent declares a command for the target, as a reaction, make a tremor roll of D6 for the target. On a 5+, unless they spend 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, add 2 to tremor rolls for the target.

armies_of_renown.name: Mawseeker Gollop
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Ogor Mawtribes faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Mawseeker Gollop Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Ogor Mawtribes faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options below. All units in your army gain the GOLLOP keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Any MAWSEEKERS units
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

battle_traits.name: Prepare the Feast
battle_traits.effect: If there is no friendly Feastmaster on the battlefield, pick a friendly GOLLOP HERO to be the Feastmaster for the rest of the battle.

battle_traits.name: Ooh, That Looks Tasty...
battle_traits.effect:
Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, you gain a number of raw ingredients.

The number of raw ingredients yielded by a destroyed unit is the Health characteristic of that unit multiplied by the number of starting models in that unit.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: If a destroyed enemy unit had a Health characteristic of 2 and its starting size was 10 models, it would yield 20 raw ingredients when it was destroyed.

battle_traits.name: Gland Goulash
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, when making casting rolls and unbinding rolls for friendly GOLLOP units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster.

battle_traits.name: Bone-Slurry Soup
battle_traits.effect: Heal (D6) each friendly GOLLOP unit that is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster.

battle_traits.name: The Organ Platter
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the phase, while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly Feastmaster, melee weapons used by friendly GOLLOP units have Crit (Mortal).

battle_traits.name: Gore-Offal Dumplings
battle_traits.effect: Each friendly GOLLOP unit that is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster can immediately use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase, but subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making the charge roll for that unit.

battle_traits.name: Unwashed Innards
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 4 to run rolls for friendly GOLLOP units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster.

battle_traits.name: Fried Limbs
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 3 to charge rolls for friendly GOLLOP units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster.

entries.name: Indomitable Guts
entries.effect: Add 1 to ward rolls for this unit.

entries.name: Overflowing Larder
entries.effect: Gain D6 raw ingredients. If this unit is a Feastmaster, gain D3+3 raw ingredients instead.

entries.name: Bonecruncher
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GOLLOP WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Gain a number of raw ingredients equal to the number of those damage points that are allocated to the target.

entries.name: Bloodgruel
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GOLLOP WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly GOLLOP unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• Return 1 slain model to the target.
• Heal (D6) the target.

entries.name: The Cosmos Writhes
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GOLLOP WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly GOLLOP unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

armies_of_renown.name: Meatfist Mawtribe
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Ogor Mawtribes faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Meatfist Mawtribe Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Ogor Mawtribes faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the MEATFIST keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Any GUTBUSTER units
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

battle_traits.name: Bloodthirsty Arrogance
battle_traits.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets a friendly MEATFIST INFANTRY unit that did not charge in the same turn, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

battle_traits.name: Fleshy Stampede
battle_traits.effect: Add 2 to run rolls for friendly MEATFIST units.

battle_traits.name: Meaty Charge
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly MEATFIST unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this phase to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Make a meaty charge roll by rolling a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll made this turn for the unit using this ability. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability has more models than the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

battle_traits.name: The Unstoppable Feast
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly MEATFIST unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this battle to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability earlier in the same turn.

battle_traits.name: Gluttonous Conquerors
battle_traits.effect: Add 1 to the Control characteristic of friendly MEATFIST units while they are in combat.

battle_traits.name: Greedy Chompers
battle_traits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly MEATFIST units that are in combat to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, Heal (X) the target where X is equal to the roll.

battle_traits.name: Gruesome Devourers
battle_traits.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by a friendly MEATFIST unit's combat attacks to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target cannot use RETREAT abilities.

entries.name: Thick Blubber
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

entries.name: Overpowering Mass
entries.effect: When making meaty charge rolls for this unit, you can re-roll unmodified rolls of 1.

entries.name: Force of Savage Personality
entries.effect: Enemy units and enemy MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Snott, Gnoblar Thief
entries.declare: Pick a visible enemy HERO that has any artefacts of power to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or lower than the current battle round number, the target no longer has any artefacts of power.

entries.name: Trapper's Arsenal
entries.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Rusty Leadbelcher Gun
entries.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Pick to load the gun with Jagged Shrapnel or Lumpen Metal Scrap, then apply the corresponding effect below:

options.name: Jagged Shrapnel
options.text: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models were slain by that mortal damage, halve the target's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Lumpen Metal Scrap
options.text: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.

armies_of_renown.name: The Roving Maw
armies_of_renown.text:
Where the ground itself groans with hunger and opens in undulating gullets, twisted, feral shapes slaughter errant warriors to feed to the grisly apertures. These are the Gorger Mawpacks, ogors afflicted with a terrible curse that keeps them in a permanent state of starvation. Ogor Butchers will often travel with these creatures in Roving Maws, testing new recipes upon them and opening Mawpits with gastromantic rituals.
When you pick the Ogor Mawtribes faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a The Roving Maw Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Ogor Mawtribes faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the ROVING MAW keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Any non-UNIQUE MAWSEEKER units
Any non-UNIQUE GUTBUSTERS units
Gorger Mawpacks
You cannot include Regiments of Renown or a Great Mawpot

battle_traits.name: Tasty Morsels
battle_traits.effect: Each time a model is slain by a friendly Mawpit’s ‘Hungry Sinkhole’ ability, you gain 1 tasty morsel.

battle_traits.name: Driven by Starvation
battle_traits.effect: Friendly Gorger Mawpack units can use CHARGE abilities even if they used a RUN ability in the same turn unless they are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature.

battle_traits.name: Trampling Charge
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly ROVING MAW unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battle_traits.name: The Realm Hungers
battle_traits.effect: Units and MANIFESTATIONS are vulnerable to Mawpits while they are on the battlefield unless they are wholly within 1" of a terrain feature that is not a Mawpit. This ability has no effect on ROVING MAW units or units that have FLY.

battle_traits.name: Mawpits of Ghur
battle_traits.effect:
Roll 2D6 and add the number of tasty morsels you have to the roll. Apply the corresponding effect below for the rest of the battle round. Then, reset your tasty morsels to 0.
2-3 – Subdued: No effect.
4-5 – Peckish: Subtract 3 from the control scores of units that are vulnerable to Mawpits.
6-8 – Rumbling: Roll a dice for each unit that is vulnerable to Mawpits. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.
9-11 – Famished: Units that are vulnerable to Mawpits cannot use commands.
12+ – Ravenous: Roll a D3 for each unit that is vulnerable to Mawpits. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

entries.name: Prime Gutserver
entries.effect: If this unit is within 1" of a friendly Mawpit, gain 1 tasty morsel.

entries.name: Flasks of Congealed Maw-juices
entries.effect: Friendly Mawpits within this unit's combat range have WARD (5+).

entries.name: Mawmeat
entries.declare: Pick a friendly ROVING MAW WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: For the rest of the battle, units on or within 1" of the target are vulnerable to Mawpits. This ability has no effect on ROVING MAW units or units that have FLY.

entries.name: Retcher
entries.declare: Pick a friendly ROVING MAW WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Add 2 to the Rend characteristic of the caster's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
